questions.learningObjective: calculate the sample standard deviation of replicate data
questions.stem: Sample 0401: Five replicate measurements are 10.24, 9.04, 10.98, 10.12, 10.85. What is the sample standard deviation?

options.misconception: returns the average instead of a measure of spread

questions.explanation: The sample standard deviation measures spread about the mean and divides the sum of squared deviations by n minus one, which corrects the bias for a finite sample. Dividing by n gives the population value, and the square of the standard deviation is the variance.
questions.hint: Use n minus one in the denominator for sample data.
